reason: Guest explicitly describes swing trading rules for US stocks (initial move + 5-day base + breakout above) that can be approximated on daily bars.

universe.description: US stocks showing initial moves and consolidations

setup.rule: stock puts in an initial move, bases out for at least 5 days
setup.quote: I look for a stock that puts in an initial move, bases out for at least 5 days, and once it gets above that initial move, I buy the stock.

entry.rule: buy when price gets above the initial move high after 5-day base
entry.quote: once it gets above that initial move, I buy the stock

market_filter.rule: only in uptrending market with defined ranges
market_filter.quote: when there's a uptrending market, I don't even want to day trade... I make my money as a swing trader when there's a trending market, there's defined ranges

ambiguities.issue: no numeric values for momentum_min_pct, consolidation_max_range_pct, trail_ma or stops
ambiguities.assumption: use 5 days as consolidation_days and default other params to null

ambiguities.issue: mentions supply zones and 60-min pivots but no exact definition
ambiguities.assumption: treat as discretionary overlay not codable on daily bars
